name: Article 6, § 4 – 347
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on the Union Civil Protection Mechanism and Union support for health emergency preparedness and response, and repealing Decision No 1313/2013/EU (Union Civil Protection Mechanism)
part_text: 4. The financial envelope referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article and the amounts of additional resources referred to in Article 7 may be used for technical and administrative assistance only to the extent strictly necessary for the implementation of this Regulation. Such expenditure shall be separately identified in the annual budgetary reporting. It shall not finance corporate communication on the political priorities of the Union. Operational information necessary for disaster prevention, preparedness and response may be financed. No expenditure under this Regulation shall finance the establishment or operation of a separate cross-sectoral crisis coordination structure or a temporary arrangement replacing such a structure.
